subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of 14 new executable action revisions across secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and repository-write workflows?
rationale: CI verifies the resulting workflows but cannot decide whether the upstream privilege, sandbox, token, and publishing behavior changes are acceptable within OpenClaw's intended trust boundary.

options.title: Refresh and approve the group
options.body: Rebase the branch, inspect the exact upstream release and source deltas, and approve the grouped immutable-pin update if each credentialed workflow retains its intended boundary.

options.title: Split privileged actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, Docker publishing, and repository-write actions into smaller PRs so each sensitive executable delta can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until direct Codex contract proof and a complete exact-head check run are available.

recommendation.title: Refresh and approve the group
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, inspect the exact upstream release and source deltas, and approve the grouped immutable-pin update if each credentialed workflow retains its intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to Docker release safeguards and full-release validation on the most consequential publishing surface in the PR.
